networks.name: agentic_web_doctor
networks.description: Audit any website for Open Agentic Web (MVP 0.3) conformance, inspect trust boundaries & security gates, and generate ready-to-deploy static agentic site bundles.
sample_queries: Run a full Self-Audit on this website's Open Agentic Web conformance.
Audit a site's trust boundaries, peer_policy, and BYOK security posture.
Generate a compliant agent-manifest.json and network.json scaffold for an AI SaaS documentation site.
Explain what makes a website pass Stage One of the Open Agentic Web Challenge.

peer_policy.note: Read-only CORS inspection of user-specified peer manifests requires explicit visitor initiation; credentials are never forwarded to peer origins.

agent_mcp.reason: Static bundle exposing deterministic browser-side WebMCP tools and portable manifest schema.

items.name: audit_agentic_site
items.purpose: Inspect an agent-manifest.json and linked network.json for MVP Profile 0.3 conformance.

items.name: inspect_security_gate
items.purpose: Evaluate peer_policy, sly_data filtering, CORS posture, and BYOK credential safety.

items.name: generate_agentic_scaffold
items.purpose: Generate downloadable compliant agent-manifest.json, network.json, and links.json files.
